names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 15 апреля ст. ст., name page 14246, «Александр (Гневушев), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank word and the grade left off; the day's own line declines the forename and gives no surname at all. The surname in brackets is part of the name the calendar's link gives and is kept. No folder in this corpus holds this name form, and none holds the fold key the gate makes of it, «александр гневушев», which the bare «александр» fold of twelve folders does not reach. The surname alone is borne by one other folder in this corpus, a bishop of Orel and Sevsk shot in 1918; nothing read links the two men, and the calendar says nothing of either's kin.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 апреля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Александра пресвитера (1930).»
source.note: The last of the day's five entries, standing on a line of its own, and the whole of it. The day's one typikon icon stands before the first entry, the three apostles of the Seventy, so no `rank` is recorded here. The day page prints no life under his name and there is no life page behind the line; its one hymn under «Молитвы» is a kontakion of the apostles and belongs to that first entry. The name page behind the line (14246) gives «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 15 апреля»: the January day is the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia, a commemoration of a company and not a second day of his own, so no second row and no note of a second feast is written. That page prints an icon of him and nothing else.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 15 апреля ст. ст. with «(1930)», which is this calendar's way of printing the year of death. It is the only year any source read for this folder gives him, and the page says nothing of where or how. No day is recorded because this corpus records years.
